(gmail.modify), each with its own tick box, all pre-ticked under "Select all" — unticked, sending would be a boundary; this shape assumes the default. excess.note: Anthropic: "Send, reply to, and forward emails from Gmail." and "During authentication, Google's OAuth screen mentions email sending permissions... Claude can send, reply to, and forward emails, but only does so with your explicit approval by default." The directory listing names reply and forward; Google's own reference for the same server (2026-07-21) names no tool that sends — see contradictions.
